cards.program: Haas Fong Master of Financial Engineering (MFE)
cards.schedule_note: Program shifting from March start to January start for cohorts from 2027 onward (Haas MFE program update blog). Summer or fall internship option within one-year format. Not a traditional autumn MSF calendar.
cards.internship_rate: Program blog (2025 update): matched 96% of a recent cohort with an internship over fall/winter 2025. Class of 2025 internship offer list published on MFE Offers page (rate denominator not separately tabulated on placements page this run).
cards.full_time_placement: Class of 2025: 70 seekers; 67 received offers; 67 accepted (≈95.7% accept / 96% offer among seekers) — official Haas MFE Placement Report.
cards.full_time_placement_notes: Compensation Class of 2025: mean base $148,318; median base $150,000; high base $215,000; mean signing $34,267; median signing $40,000; high signing $90,000. Industries: IB 31%, AM 28%, HF 19%, Trading 12%, Other/FinTech 9%. Functions: portfolio mgmt/quant research & analysis 55%, trading 12%, strats/structuring 10%, portfolio management 6%, quant developer 5%, data science+ML/AI 5%, other 7%. Locations: East Coast 60%, US Other 13%, International 13%, California 10%, Chicago 5%. LABEL: Quant/MFE — not a TFE MSF rank entry.
cards.notable_employers_notes: Recent Hiring Firms list on official Class of 2025 Placement Report; internship offers Class of 2025 also include Cubist, QRT, Schonfeld, DRW, PIMCO, Vanguard, etc.
cards.top_finance_firm_signal: Extremely high for quant research/PM, trading, and markets roles at bulge + HF/prop (Millennium, Point72, Squarepoint, Optiver, Jump).
sample_alumni_paths: Portfolio management / quant research and analysis
cards.referral_network_notes: Dedicated Haas MFE career services; East Coast–heavy placements; Haas alumni network. Formal cold-outreach ease: unknown.
cards.difficulty_notes: Highly selective one-year MFE; QuantNet/TFE MFE rankings often #1-tier — do NOT treat as MSF TFE spine rank. Intense quant bar.
cards.intl_student_notes: Historically international-heavy MFE; confirm STEM designation and January-2027 start visa timing for Fall 2027 planning language (intake is Jan 2027 for MFE27).

cards.program: Mathematical and Computational Finance (MCF) — ICME M.S. track
cards.schedule_note: Official name is Mathematical and Computational Finance (MCF), an interdisciplinary track in Stanford ICME (School of Engineering) — NOT 'Master of Computational Finance'. Typically 45 units over 5–6 quarters. Relocated/relaunched from Statistics Financial Mathematics into Engineering ICME in 2014 (FAQ).
cards.internship_rate: FAQ: nearly 100% placement rate for students desiring internships in recent years (no seeker denominator table).
cards.full_time_placement: MCF FAQ: nearly 100% placement rate for students desiring full-time industry employment in recent years (explicitly not guaranteed). No MCF-only CSEA PDF with salary/timing denominators located this run.
cards.full_time_placement_notes: Target cohort ~10–15 students; ~5% admission rate (FAQ). ICME MS Graduates Employment Report 2024–2025 lists titles (Quant Researcher, Data Scientist, Software Engineer, etc.) and orgs including Balyasny, BlackRock, Morgan Stanley, Point72, Qube, Vanguard — but report covers ICME MS broadly (not MCF-only breakout) and notes incomplete public/self-reported coverage. Alumni geography clusters: NYC, SF Bay, London, Hong Kong (FAQ). LABEL: Quant/MCF — never MSF TFE; never Stanford GSB.
cards.notable_employers_notes: Finance companies named on MCF FAQ as having offered internships/employment in past few years; ICME 2024–2025 MS report adds overlapping names (Balyasny, BlackRock, Morgan Stanley, Point72, Qube, Vanguard) without MCF-only filter.
cards.top_finance_firm_signal: Extremely high potential per tiny selective cohort + named elite firms on FAQ; quantified placement/salary still thin vs CMU/Berkeley PDFs.
cards.big_tech_or_top_firm_signal: ICME MS report also shows tech employers (Amazon, Microsoft, Netflix, Waymo, Hugging Face) — MCF students may take fintech/tech paths; MCF-specific mix unknown.
sample_alumni_paths: Continued PhD study (separate ICME PhD application required)
cards.referral_network_notes: ICME Career Services + Affiliates Program; annual ICME Career Forum. Small cohort mentoring. Formal referral ease: unknown.
cards.difficulty_notes: ~10–15 seats / ~5% admit (FAQ). PhD-level quantitative rigor claim. Not Stanford GSB MBA; not MS&E Financial Analytics concentration.
cards.intl_student_notes: Confirm STEM CIP for ICME MS / MCF track and 5–6 quarter calendar for Fall 2027 visa planning. California location; FAQ says NY banking placement historically not a geographic blocker.
